handoff: Review #1: 2 blocking. The old-layout code the plan removes is still there, dead (store layout.ts, OLD_* paths, cli layoutRefusal, toOldLayout). norn config says norn upgrade records a missing norn_version, but upgrade now refuses that repo. Tests and typecheck green; 7 minor or nit notes.

findings.title: Old-layout code the plan removes is still in the tree, dead
findings.criterion: user story 18 (no command carries old-layout code)
findings.detail:
Spec Plan D10: 'What goes …: the old-layout module, `repoLayout`/`layoutProblems`, the `OLD_*` paths and the old tick lock path in store; … the cli layout guard'. Seams section: '`toOldLayout` … go with their last user'. What is left: packages/store/src/layout.ts (repoLayout, layoutProblems, Layout; still exported from packages/store/src/index.ts:15); packages/store/src/paths.ts:24-27 (OLD_NORN_DIR, OLD_CONFIG_FILE, OLD_WORKFLOWS_DIR, OLD_TRACE_DIR); packages/cli/src/runtime/layout.ts:1-20 (layoutRefusal has no caller, and its header claims to be `norn upgrade`'s refusal); test/support/harness.ts:459 toOldLayout (no users); docs/development.md:26 'layout.ts (old/new/both)'. The only remaining users of OLD_* are tests: help-tree.test.ts:11 and upgrade.test.ts:12. Behaviour is right because no command reaches this code, but a removal the spec names is not done, and the dead code carries false comments.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Delete store layout.ts and its export, the OLD_* constants, cli runtime/layout.ts and toOldLayout. Spell `.agents/norn` and `.agents/norn/config.yaml` as literals in the two tests (as the harness's layoutPlaces does). Drop the layout.ts mention from docs/development.md. Verify: `grep -rnw 'repoLayout\|layoutProblems\|layoutRefusal\|OLD_CONFIG_FILE\|OLD_TRACE_DIR\|OLD_WORKFLOWS_DIR\|OLD_NORN_DIR\|toOldLayout' packages test` finds nothing; typecheck and unit tier green.

findings.title: `norn config` says `norn upgrade` records a missing norn_version; upgrade now refuses that repo
findings.criterion: user story 11 / D1 (missing norn_version refused; the rule alone words it)
findings.detail:
NULL_MEANS.norn_version = 'not recorded: `norn upgrade` records it'. `norn config get norn_version` / `config list` show this to a person, and packages/cli/test/integration/config.test.ts:424-429 ('B4: without the key, get shows no value and that norn upgrade records it') pins it. After this story, `norn upgrade` on that repo exits 3 with version_missing (03.AC7). So the hint sends the person to a command that refuses. Story 11 wants the do_instead to name `norn init` and the 0.30 path. D1 says the baseline rule's text is the one wording.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Reword the null meaning, e.g. 'not recorded: `norn init` records it on a new repo; a repo from an older norn takes the 0.30 path' (or reuse the core baseline text). Update the B4 test to match.

findings.title: version_missing hint can loop back to norn init
findings.detail:
On a team file with no norn_version, `norn init` (init.ts:294-297) refuses with the do_instead 'run `norn init` if norn was never set up here …', which is circular coming from init itself. QA raised this too. 04.AC3 still passes as written.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: A person decides whether init should give only the 0.30 path, or say to add norn_version / remove the hand-written team file.

findings.title: Upgrade applies the baseline before the config loads
findings.detail:
D4: 'A config that fails to load stays the command's own config error (exit 6), never this refusal'. Upgrade reads the version from the team file and refuses before `ctx.resolved`. A broken config with no version therefore gets version_missing (exit 3) from upgrade, not exit 6. The comment says this is deliberate. No test covers the combination.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Person to confirm the order, or load config first.

findings.title: Production code kept only for tests
findings.detail:
treeRecordCommit / TreeRecordFailure (record-ref.ts:429-457) and treeStoryRunStatePath (packages/schema/src/ids.ts:309) are used only by test/support/harness.ts archiveTreeRunState. The harness doc still calls it 'what `norn upgrade` does'. GitPort.move (packages/core/src/ports.ts:188) and its git adapter now have no production caller, only the contract test.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move the packing into the harness, or drop it; drop GitPort.move with its contract case.

findings.title: The 05.AC2 hook test passes on the old code too
findings.detail:
The test asserts exit 0 and no 'layout' in the output. The removed hook line returned {} silently on the old layout, so the old code passed the same test.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Assert an effect of the hook proceeding (e.g. a Stop blocked with the report instruction).

findings.title: Stale comments and texts after the removals
findings.detail:
The comment 'Run state an older norn left on the base, pointed to `norn upgrade`' remains over a deleted line in observe/index.ts:522 and packages/view/src/load.ts:474. packages/store/src/fsx.ts:16 says needs_removed is fixed by `norn upgrade`. docs/limitations.md:29 says 'since its run state was moved off the branch'.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Delete or reword.

findings.title: One transcript line gone: the branch-tree runs read
findings.detail:
06.AC4 says transcripts are unchanged. One `git cat-file -e …/runs` line went, which is exactly the reader slice 06 removes. Golden corpus and snapshots hold. Waiting on a person's ruling, already raised by QA.

Suggestion: Person confirms.
